rationale: The original thesis relied on an immediate rejection at the 5-minute 9-EMA ($28.85) to drive a breakdown, but price stalled at $28.82 for several minutes before grinding higher on expanding 1-minute volume to reclaim the 9-EMA at $28.88. With the immediate downside momentum failing to materialize and price pressing right up against the $28.91 stop, closing now cuts the trade before full stop-out while avoiding a counter-trend long far below session VWAP ($29.25).
